scope: Worker staging for offline structure undo, with owner-thread publication
expected_observed: Undo menu starts busy and returns before owner snapshot reads; immediate cancel leaves live geometry and exact prior file bytes intact; retry succeeds.
History/save callbacks execute off owner; no live/durable mutation before publication; publication preserves current health/inventory/drop state and restart bytes.
Changed destination, model revision, missing proofs, cancellation and publication failure reject safely and retain undo record until success.
Actual blocked atomic rename restores live world/history and preserves prior file bytes; legacy synchronous undo can retry the same retained record.
Stable trusted chunk proofs avoid repeated engine equality scans; unknown or changed proofs fall back to authoritative cell comparisons.
limits: No cap raised or rollout qualification claimed.

Final owner publication still scans/copies/replaces cells and may perform fallback equality checks; legacy custom history maps still use synchronous saving. No 100 ms stall/latency guarantee established.
Full city/maximum admission, disk-backed live root/region work, 20-run full-fixture, physicalGPU and shaped32client qualification remain pending.
No full-suite rerun claimed this turn.
